THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
FANTASY & PERIOD
062
STUDY 019
Silver Beaded Headdress on a Misty Shore
Rights check
Source: 24598.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman wears a silver headdress of
dangling beads and small chains that frame her face.
Two long dark braids fall over a cream embroidered
brocade coat with silver trim. She stands before
weathered driftwood, with a misty green-blue shoreline
behind her. Her expression is composed, with a
serious, quiet gaze. Soft overcast light, a muted palette
of silver, cream, slate blue, and deep moss green.
Sculptural and mystical, in the style of a high-fashion
editorial shot on film.
Mystical, sculptural, muted
WORKING NOTES
- The headdress is the focal point; describe its beads and
chains precisely.
- Remove the driftwood for a cleaner, more minimal shot.
